Before reconciliation the finance files already shared ids for every entity that more than one file described (min:ministry-of-finance in six files, fin:ibrd/fin:ida in four, fin:adb/aiib/ndb/jica/ncrtc/dfccil in two or three, etc.), so no cross-file id rewrite was needed; the entity-resolution faults were inside worldbank-projects.json (implementing agencies placed on the state-government node while the same body had its own node, and one Haryana department resolved to a Union ministry by name) and two conflated debarment nodes in contracts.json.

No claim needed killing and no contra had to be added: the two alleged non-contra claims (debt:c020, literature:c017) are each answered by a contra in their own file (debt:c021, literature:c018), every analytic-tier claim carries an innocentReading, and the one resolved:false entity (fin:shapoorji-pallonji) carries no claim.

worldbank-projects.json is written by scripts/finance/fetch-worldbank.mjs; a re-fetch would re-create the fixes listed for that file (the fetcher's hand-alias map resolves "Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare" to the Union ministry, and composite "<society>, Government of <state>" strings to the state). The same corrections belong in the fetcher's HAND/INV_AL tables.

Sentinel debarment end dates (2999-12-31, the feed's marker for indefinite or conditional-release debarment) were recorded as to: null with the marker explained in d; real end dates (e.g. 2028-01-20, 2031-01-16, 2026-11-08) were kept.

fin:laxminarayan-construction was kept as one node although the feed lists firm and proprietor variants: a sole proprietorship and its proprietor are one legal person, debarred together under the same cases.

Post-reconciliation: every fix to worldbank-projects.json was ported into scripts/finance/fetch-worldbank.mjs (typo normalisation, SAME_AS spellings, the society-of-parent-government rule, PROJECT_READINGS for P512898, counter-guarantee stripping, GENERIC_ORGANS, INV_ST seats, qualified state-node aliases, the 2999 sentinel); the file is again fetcher output (runId 5594d0e72abaf6ca). SECI's AIIB facts, which the editor had merged into the generated file, moved back to adb-aiib.json as a minimal hand record.
